Class FirestoreImportOrders

public class FirestoreImportOrders
extends FirestoreService.ImportRecordsLogic

Extends ImportRecordsLogic to implement order import logic from Firestore. Processes BlazeBiteOrders documents into Order2__c records, including item/customization aggregation, tax calculations, currency conversion, and customer info harmonization.

Group:
    Import Logic

Since:
    04/03/2021

Version:
    2.0


Change Log

  • 04/03/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 04/21/2021 - v1.1 - Fixes tax calculation.
  • 06/03/2021 - v1.2 - Methods now use class FirestoreService instead of FirestoreController.
  • 08/01/2021 - v1.3 - Make sure orders are within the date range if provided.
  • 10/23/2023 - v1.4 - Change logic to sum orders: item price now includes customization price.
  • 03/05/2024 - v1.5 - The account currency is now used to define the order currency.
  • 03/10/2024 - v1.6 - Adds logic to calculate the conversion rate.
  • 08/28/2024 - v1.7 - Use abbreviation to make sure fields don't go over the max length.
  • 10/04/2025 - v1.8 - Added payment method field.
  • 10/28/2025 - v1.9 - Make sure email is valid.
  • 03/28/2026 - v2.0 - Update ApexDoc comments to follow standard format. API version updated to 66.0.
